value.rationale: Edge-change sensitivity of sequential bi-threshold attractors is an explicitly motivated question of the 2011 original paper. The one-edge transition from a tree to a unicyclic triangle graph creates a uniform quadratic-period orbit on linearly many vertices, with a transparent exactly beta-2 delay and two coprime clocks. The theorem is an all-parameter structural construction rather than an arbitrary finite search or numerical improvement.
